_comment: Utilities of the API Explorer (category 'utilities'): the functions written by hand in helpers_headers/templates/ (utils_generator.py), outside the registry. One card per entry: `name` (identifier of the card, unique among the registry functions too), `label` (shown name), `description`, `apis` (signatures in each API, an empty list when the API has none; <type> and <lmul> are the suffixes of the C names), `headers` (header of each API) and `doc` (page of the user documentation, relative to docs/, with its anchor). Read by gen_mipp_api_data.py.

utilities.name: malloc
utilities.label: malloc / free / is_aligned
utilities.description: Memory aligned for the aligned loads and stores, on `MIPP_REQUIRED_ALIGNMENT` bytes (the size of a register). The C size is rounded up to a multiple of the alignment; `NULL` / `nullptr` on failure.

utilities.name: vector
utilities.label: allocator / vector
utilities.description: Standard allocator aligned on `MIPP_REQUIRED_ALIGNMENT`, and `std::vector` whose `data()` is aligned for `load` / `store`.

cpp: template <typename T> using mipp::vector = std::vector<T, mipp::allocator<T>>;
obj: template <typename T> using mipp::vector = std::vector<T, mipp::allocator<T>>;

utilities.name: dump
utilities.label: dump / operator<<
utilities.description: Prints the lanes of a register, `[0, 1, 2, 3 | 4, 5, 6, 7]` with a `|` between the 128-bit blocks, or of a mask (`1` for an active lane).

cpp: template <typename T, int LMUL = 1> std::ostream& mipp::dump(const vd<T, LMUL>& r, std::ostream& os = std::cout);
template <typename T, int LMUL = 1> std::ostream& mipp::dump_k(const vm<T, LMUL>& m, std::ostream& os = std::cout);
obj: template <typename T, int LMUL> std::ostream& operator<<(std::ostream& os, const Vd<T, LMUL>& r);
template <typename T, int LMUL> std::ostream& operator<<(std::ostream& os, const Vm<T, LMUL>& m);

utilities.name: reduce
utilities.label: reduce
utilities.description: Reduces the lanes of a register, or the `n` elements of an array (`n` $\geq 1$), with an associative and commutative operation `op(Vd, Vd) -> Vd` that accepts every LMUL: `mipp::op::add`, `mul`, `min`, `max`, `andb`, `orb`, `xorb`, or a functor with a template `operator()`.

obj: template <typename T, int LMUL, typename OP> T mipp::reduce(const Vd<T, LMUL>& r, OP op);
template <typename T, int LMUL = 1, typename OP> T mipp::reduce(const T* data, std::size_t n, OP op);
struct mipp::op::add; // and mul, min, max, andb, orb, xorb

utilities.name: transpose
utilities.label: transpose
utilities.description: In place on an array of `N` registers, the rows of a square matrix: they become the rows of its transpose (`t[i]` lane `j` receives the former `t[j]` lane `i`).

cpp: template <typename T, int LMUL = 1> void mipp::transpose(vd<T, LMUL> (&t)[N<T, LMUL>()]);
obj: template <typename T, int LMUL> void mipp::transpose(Vd<T, LMUL> (&t)[Vd<T, LMUL>::N()]);

utilities.name: transpose_b128
utilities.label: transpose_b128
utilities.description: In place on an array of `16 / sizeof(T)` registers: the matrix of each block of 128 bits is transposed independently (4 x 4 for `float32`, 8 x 8 for `int16`...).

cpp: template <typename T, int LMUL = 1> void mipp::transpose_b128(vd<T, LMUL> (&t)[16 / sizeof(T)]);
obj: template <typename T, int LMUL> void mipp::transpose_b128(Vd<T, LMUL> (&t)[16 / sizeof(T)]);

utilities.name: permute_pattern
utilities.label:
permute

/ permute2
utilities.description: Permutations whose indices are known at compile time (C++17), given by a pattern `P` with `static constexpr int get(int i, int n)` (`-1` for a zero): replaced by a named rearrangement when there is one, a `permute` with a constant table otherwise.

cpp: template <typename P, typename R> R mipp::permute(const R& r);
template <typename P, typename R> R mipp::permute2(const R& vd0, const R& vd1);
obj: template <typename P, typename T, int LMUL> Vd<T, LMUL> mipp::permute(const Vd<T, LMUL>& r);
template <typename P, typename T, int LMUL> Vd<T, LMUL> mipp::permute2(const Vd<T, LMUL>& vd0, const Vd<T, LMUL>& vd1);

utilities.name: info
utilities.label: mipp_info
utilities.description: Prints the target to `stdout`: OS, compiler, active SIMD extension and size of the registers.
